# Invoicely

Invoicely is a free, privacy-first, offline-first billing and financial management suite for freelancers, entrepreneurs, and small businesses. It runs entirely in the browser and saves all data locally.

## Features

- **Invoice Wizard**: Step-by-step guidance for date, company, customer, line items, signature, and design templates.
- **Receipt Maker**: Streamlined builder for quick sales receipts.
- **Client & Inventory Directories**: Offline customer directory and product databases.
- **Ledger & Analytics**: Spreadsheet-style financial logging and performance reports.
- **Business Toolkit**: A set of six specialized financial calculators (Taxes, Profit Margins, Discounts, Unit Price, Late Fees, and ROI).
- **Privacy-First**: No tracking, cookies, or backend servers. Uses persistent browser LocalStorage and IndexedDB.

## Site Structure (Sitemap)

- `/`: Primary Invoice Wizard & template selector.
- `/receipt`: Receipt creator.
- `/clients`: Customer manager and local directory.
- `/inventory`: Product catalog and service pricing tracker.
- `/history`: Record archives of generated invoices and receipts.
- `/ledger`: Sales breakdowns, revenue charts, and transaction ledger sheets.
- `/tools`: Multi-purpose business calculators.
- `/about`: Project values and technical description.
- `/sitemap.xml`: Standard XML sitemap.
- `/llms.txt`: This machine-readable LLM documentation file.
